notes: Core 3 resources + 1 safety meter. Real NASA baselines (0.84 kg O2/day, 2.5 L water/day, 95% ECLSS recovery, 250 mSv 6-month ALARA limit) are paired with kid-friendly combined percentages and 90-day initial food reserves.

coreMeters.label: POWER
coreMeters.description: Battery energy stored from solar panels and backup power.
coreMeters.chainReactionWarning: Low Power! Life support recycling slows down, greenhouse lights dim, and shield systems drain faster.

coreMeters.label: LIFE SUPPORT
coreMeters.description: Combines breathable Oxygen (O2) and clean Water (H2O) into one life-support meter. Tap to see both!
coreMeters.realVsSimplifiedNote: NASA tracks O2 partial pressure and potable water tanks separately; combined into one bar for grades 3-6 clarity with an expandable O2/H2O view.

coreMeters.label: FOOD
coreMeters.description: Stored astronaut meal packs (90 days at start, non-renewable) plus fresh veggies grown in your greenhouse.
coreMeters.realVsSimplifiedNote: Starting 90-day ration count gives kids clear urgency to build and tend a greenhouse before stored packs run out.

safetyMeter.label: SHIELD
safetyMeter.description: How strongly your habitat blocks cosmic rays and solar proton storms. Tied to your crew's hidden cumulative radiation dose (250 mSv NASA limit).
safetyMeter.realVsSimplifiedNote: Real flight surgeons track cumulative effective dose in millisieverts (mSv); shown as a simple Shield % bar while tracking true mSv internally for debriefs.
